title: Leg Before Wicket (LBW)
summary: The batter is out if the ball hits their body instead of the bat and would have hit the stumps. The ball must have been a fair delivery and not have touched the bat first.
conditions: The bowler delivers a fair ball
The ball lands in line or on the off side
The ball hits the batter's body without touching the bat first
The impact is in line with the wickets or outside the off stump
The ball would have hit the wickets if not intercepted
